semantic.justification: Original GregorianCalendar is now concrete and implements status/default, locale, adopted zone with explicit/default locale, named const-reference zone constructor overloads, date/date-time, copy, assignment and clone. Constructor dispatch only represents declared C++ overloads; it does not infer a calendar type or parsing rule. Default/locale/zone forms evaluate source UTC getNow and setTime after base initialization even for a failed setter status; numeric date forms evaluate default-zone/default-locale arguments and set source fields without now. Copy construction and clone copy the five derived fields. Assignment clones base ownership and copies only the three cutover fields, retaining destination resolver flags in source write order (CALC-343). The native witness supplies distinct boolean resolver states to distinguish these contracts. Original Julian/Gregorian hybrid arithmetic, signed64 month starts, limits, precedence, checked normalization and cutover shifts remain unchanged. The reference factory is explicit because JS cannot overload pointer ownership by C++ constness; its tag preserves source clone timing in the actual base constructor. Unchanged ICU78.3 library witnesses pass 14994 locale/week cases over 993 requested names and 1440 constructor/copy/weekend cases. They observe all six week/weekend fields, valid/actual Locale values and literal root IDs, incoming error/warning behavior, default and keyword timezone selection, reference/adoption clone counts, null/error and aliased-status clone callbacks, all initialized field/stamp/flag and derived state, date-versus-clock initialization, completed UTC fields and weekend work clones. Existing 63050 scalar/calendar and 12929 time cases also pass after fixtures use real constructors and explicit public controlled baselines.
